title: BitmapFactory.Options：inSampleSize、inBitmap 与解码峰值
key_conclusions: Bitmap decode optimization should target peak memory, not only final retained memory.
Bounds pass and inSampleSize reduce pixel allocation before decode, while inBitmap and BitmapPool reduce repeated allocations.
Transforms can temporarily hold source and target Bitmaps at the same time, so they must be included in peak analysis.
Validation requires before/after Native Heap, Graphics, HPROF, and cache plateau evidence.
shallow_points: The article does not include real decoder traces or meminfo timelines.
It does not validate inBitmap compatibility rules across Android versions and decoder paths.
It does not include runnable samples for large image, transform, hardware Bitmap, and BitmapPool reuse cases.
It does not quantify visual quality tradeoffs for RGB_565 or aggressive sampling.
